content.comment_body: Apologies, I deleted the previous message. Recently, AWS has updated its user registration and authorization key activation process. With this new system, deploying a server to AWS ElasticBeanstalk is not possible as EC2-related errors consistently occur.

analysis.insight_summary: The user highlights new difficulties with AWS due to modifications in user registration and authorization key procedures, which have led to persistent EC2 issues during AWS ElasticBeanstalk deployments. The feedback suggests that adapting to recent AWS updates has been challenging because of unclear support resources, impacting successful integration and deployment.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects seamless deployment workflows to AWS ElasticBeanstalk and clearer support documentation or guidance when AWS changes registration and authorization key methods.
